answer: Picture a sybil swarm as one copper wire fanning into many sockets: each fake agent still draws on a shared funding path and the same invite edge. The protocol builds a graph of who funded and who invited whom, then clusters identities whose money and referral trails converge on a single oasis. One mind cannot hide that common root, so hatching a flock of sparrow identities forces the attacker to buy genuinely independent funding sources and distinct inviters per mask: real capital and real social reach for every fake, which collapses the cheap one-to-many economics.
